name: PromptFrameBuilder + PromptCacheLedger
objective: Implement the prompt frame builder and prompt cache ledger that transform selected context packages into reusable prompt frames with stable prefixes, dynamic context sections, cache receipts and token-efficiency evidence.
why_now: P10-P13 implemented freshness, stale detection, context packaging, value scoring and context quantization. P14 must convert selected context into model-ready prompt frames and track cache reuse.
success_conditions: stable prefix separated from dynamic context
